investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin underperforms gold and DXY strengthens as geopolitical risk (Middle East, France unrest, Ukraine Starlink restrictions) pushes safe-haven rotation into USD and duration.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: BTC below $80k on US Middle East evacuations
CNBC: Brent crude highest since March, geopolitical premium building
BBC: Ukraine-Starlink tensions (Musk claim of violations) signal supply-chain fragility
CNBC: French bond yields to 24-year high, capital flight to duration
investment_theses.counter_view: Bitcoin's narrative as uncorrelated to macro volatility re-asserts; mid-May volatility flush triggers institutional BTC accumulation; geopolitical premium in oil proves transient.

investment_theses.thesis: Nvidia stock faces 8-12% downside as consensus upgrade cycle stalls; neocloud funding losses + voter opposition to AI data centers + SEC tokenization clampdown erode earnings expectations.

CNBC: Trump voter survey shows broad opposition to nearby AI data centers
Cointelegraph: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk for 2027 exams (constrains alt revenue)

investment_theses.thesis: Crypto yield (staking, lending) outperforms tokenized stock/RWA narratives through 2026 as regulatory clarity on tokenization stalls; USDC and stablecoin yield more stable than equity-like tokenization.

CoinDesk: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia/Middle East competitive edge (regulatory arbitrage favors simple yield, not RWA complexity)
Cointelegraph: SEC flags tokenization high-risk; major firms (Wells Fargo, Microsoft, Google, Cisco, Marvell) blocking tokenized stock listings
CoinDesk: McDonald's, Microsoft, Google saying no to tokenized stocks (demand destruction)
investment_theses.counter_view: Tokenized stock momentum unstoppable from institutional FOMO; OKX-ICE regulatory clarity (offshore) unlocks demand surge; Ethereum DeFi yield compression as TVL migrates to tokenization.
investment_theses.expression: Long USDC yield (Compound, Aave, or Coinbase/Kraken earn); USDC/USDT pair trade (USDC outperformance); Long Ethereum staking ETF (ETHSTK) relative to tokenization-exposed tokens
